notice: Fictional advice and source excerpts for the interface demo. These are not reviewed community recommendations.

advice.text: Poke with Pantheon's Q as Darius walks up for a last hit. Keep the trade short and leave yourself room to retreat.
advice.source_excerpt: I would look for a quick spear poke while Darius is occupied with a minion, then back out. Chasing the trade makes it harder to leave on your terms.

advice.text: Hold Pantheon's W until Darius misses his E. Take your damage window, then reset the spacing before he can answer.
advice.source_title: Saving the stun for an opening
advice.source_excerpt: Let the pull miss before you commit your stun. After the short combo, make space again instead of staying for another round of attacks.

advice.text: Step out of the outer edge of Darius's Q. Give up a last hit if taking it would leave you in range of his E.
advice.source_title: Choosing which last hits to contest
advice.source_excerpt: A minion is not worth losing a large chunk of health. Keep an exit path and watch the edge of the axe swing before walking forward.

advice.text: Back away after a short trade. Let Darius's bleed stacks expire before you approach for another last hit.
advice.source_excerpt: Do not turn two small trades into one long fight. Take enough time between them to let the bleed stacks fall off.

advice.text: Plan around your empowered ability before you trade. Use Pantheon's Q to poke, then rebuild your passive stacks before committing.
advice.source_excerpt: Check your passive stacks before stepping forward. Decide which ability you want to empower rather than spending the next cast without a plan.

advice.text: Keep Pantheon's E available when you step forward. Push the wave before looking for a roam so you do not give away a free wave.
advice.source_title: Keeping an exit and preparing a roam
advice.source_excerpt: Keep the shield ready for the opponent's response. Before leaving lane, think about where the next wave will meet and what you will miss while away.
